answers.answer: Approximately 40-70 per year. ~70 is the total for all RRMM patients seen per year (Halvorsen 2025, the most recent figure; earlier answers were ~50 in 2023 and ~60 in 2024). No document breaks out the subset with 1-4 prior lines who have had both lenalidomide and a PI, so the eligible count is at or below 70.
answers.note: Past answers rose from 50 (2023) to 60 (2024) to 70 (2025) and counted all RRMM; Dr. Elena Marsh should confirm the 1-4 line Len+PI subset.

Planned trials not yet public are not on file; Dr. Elena Marsh to answer.
10 weeks is the median from 2025, the most recent figure (2024 said ~12); local IRB approval takes another ~6 weeks, or the site can use WCG.

answers.answer: PET-CT is not on site; patients go to Valley Imaging Partners (about 5 business days to schedule). MRI and CT are on site.
answers.note: Affects scheduling for IMWG extramedullary response imaging (R8).
